title: Hadrian the Monk, Introduction to the Scriptures
english: I read Hadrian's Introduction to the Scriptures, a useful book for catechumens.
translator_notes: Greek locked from Bekker 1824; Freese 1920 used as PD English reference only.
Codex 2 of 279; Hadrian's treatise (c. 425) on biblical language and interpretation; Goessling 1887 edition with commentary exists.
